row.description: 一款Android平台本地视频播放器。核心是本地播放集成Anime4K实时超分，并围绕本地播放打造了完善的配套功能，同时接入网络存储与哔哩哔哩生态等在线播放。详情请见README。 An Android local video player. Core: local playback with integrated real-time Anime4K upscaling, complemented by robust supporting features. Also supports online playback via network storage and Bilibili. See README for details.
